text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, partner. Congrats.
We're finally entering the Classic tier this year."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's blow 'em away at full throttle. Wonder what kind
of match is waiting for us—gets me pumped. Haha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket has a bright expression.
Still, one can't help but wonder if she's pushing herself too hard...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You mean... what happened last year?
—Don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I've already settled that score.
This year is a whole new year, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no bravado in those words.
It seemed she had truly moved past her grief.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, Fuji and I were talking about doing the first calligraphy of the new year.
Let's knock it right out of the park!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: All right, finished writing! If we're talking New Year's calligraphy, it's gotta be these words!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "The absolute strongest!!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you really love that phrase, Pokke.
I suppose you're starting to see your ultimate form come together, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you have a vision yet?
Specifically, what it takes to be the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"What does it take to be the strongest, you ask?
I know I have to surpass Tachyon, but other than that, not much really..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Then in today's Twinkle Series,
there is a very clear and obvious goal.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I decide to take another look at the footage from last year.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, chosen as Umamusume of the Year!
I'd say it's truly an honor—or so I'd like to say, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I suppose.
8 wins in 8 races this year, 5 of them G1s.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because not a single person
could lay a scratch on me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: T.M.——Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right. This guy went wild last year
and closed out the Twinkle Series in style."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she was quite literally an 'Overlord.'
If one is to claim to be the strongest,
there is no avoiding Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to make sure I told you that.
Maybe I'm sticking my nose where it doesn't belong, but just so you know."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Fuji-san. Yeah, I definitely
plan on beating Opera O to a pulp someday, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, there's something I—we just have to do,
you know? Right, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Needless to say,
it was an immensely important goal for the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The regrets that Fuji-san and Trainer-aniki couldn't fulfill—
I'll definitely avenge them first, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll blaze right through the Classic Triple Crown!
And leave huge, incredible results in the Japanese Derby and other races!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No matter how fast Tachyon is,
I'll see this through to the end first!
choice_data_list: Yeah, right here—I make this promise!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown refers to—
the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's the collective name for the three classic GⅠ races that many Classic-tier Umamusume aim for this year.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "I'm not Fuji-san's apprentice or anything, nor are we related by blood. But still..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I just think of her like a little sister, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pokke... Thank you...
Yeah. That really means a lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I, too, intend to entrust you with everything.
However, don't put too much pressure on yourself—
do your best for your own sake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Jungle Pocket's passionate feelings got through.
Just at that moment...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Pokke-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
Have you done your first calligraphy of the year yet?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dants. Of course.
What did you write?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~ As for me...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Everyone, get along."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're as laid-back as ever. Even though you're pretty amazing in races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame.
The appearance of a fluffy, easygoing Umamusume from her generation instantly softened the mood.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Dantsu, what're you doing for New Year's?
Gonna go eat some sweets, as usual?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~. To be honest, I haven't really
thought about anything yet, like at all~.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then stick with us.
Let's do something with the three of us.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what should we do?
Think of something fun for us to do!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Spending New Year's with Jungle Pocket and
Dantsu Flame. Now, what should we do?"
choice_data_list: Blazing Run! First Run of the Year

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the first run of the year, huh?
Proper horse girl style, I like it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
New Year's or not, there's no time to slack off.
First thing tomorrow, I'm running toward the sunrise.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Pokke-chan is super motivated...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"You're doing it too.
Alright, tomorrow morning then, it's a promise!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAAGH!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah, wait, wait~!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ora ora oraa!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Waaah, no way I can do that~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even as she said that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to being Jungle Pocket's friend,
they were no ordinary pair. Neither yielding an inch,
they engaged in a fierce New Year's dead heat.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
A wagashi tasting! Since it's New Year's,
something like that sounds wonderful, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
In that case, allow me to recommend
a great place I know!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you really know every single
sweet shop around, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright, here it is. There are all kinds, but they're all delicious!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Telling me to pick whatever doesn't help,
so just give me your recommendation.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see.
First, this kusa mochi.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, grass mochi? What makes
the grass mochi here so special?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: In what way? Uhm...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: There are herbs kneaded into the mochi, and it has sweet bean paste inside, so... is that what makes it special?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What kind of explanation was that? It was so blatantly obvious it explained absolutely nothing!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I can do a much better job
introducing this one.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If it's my absolute favorite,
"Extra Milky Monaka," then sure!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then tell me in detail
just how tasty that Milky Monaka is.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
In detail, huh? Understood.
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Extra Milk Milky Monaka' uses plenty
of raw milk harvested in Hokkaido—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"With a smooth texture and low calories,
this snack is perfectly safe for children."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...That's what it says here.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Don't read that!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Because~ Pocket-chan told me to go into detail..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Well, whatever. For now,
let's just try eating a bunch of stuff."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deliciousness comes in many forms.
After that, they replenished their energy
while enjoying a variety of textures.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Leisurely animal watching, huh. I do like zoos. Alright, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: We're here! Rawr~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hey Pokke-chan, you said you like zoos,
so which animal is your favorite?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, you're right.
The ones I look at a lot are...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
First, the lions. Baring their fangs is cool and all,
but taking a nap is pretty nice too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Then there are the giraffes. Stretching their necks
and munching on grass, that's the good stuff.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And then the hippos. All yawning and stuff.
Plus the gorillas. How they'd pop out and...
choice_data_list: Were you just zoning out and watching?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, guess you're right.
Not like I particularly wanna see 'em acting all gallant anyway.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Well, let's just chill and watch too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking their time to enjoy themselves,
they were able to learn about the characteristics
of various animals.
